title: Halvorsen State University Biosafety Program
summary: A fictional Iowa public research university (78 BSL-2 laboratories, an Institutional Biosafety Committee, no select agents) and an exercise generated from its simulated plans: a possible exposure in a shared BSL-2 suite, conflicting guidance from the protocol, the clinic and a sponsor, and the question of whether the IBC must report to the NIH.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Halvorsen State University, its people, sponsors and sites are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/bsl2-exposure/SOURCES.md. No agent technique is described.

scenarios.title: Hairline Crack
scenarios.summary: On a Tuesday morning in October a centrifuge tube cracks in the shared third-floor BSL-2 suite in the Lindgren Life Sciences Building and a graduate student reports a possible exposure; the protocol, the clinic physician and a sponsor give conflicting advice, and the IBC chair must decide whether the event goes to the NIH.
